verified_facts.text: Selman Marrakech is a palace at the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech stands a palace of singular charm

verified_facts.text: The Arab-Moorish inspired palace bears the signature of French architect and designer Jacques Garcia.
verified_facts.excerpt: this Arab-Moorish inspired palace, where the horse reigns supreme, proudly bears the signature of the renowned French architect and designer Jacques Garcia

verified_facts.text: The hotel was conceived as a homage to the purebred Arabian horse.
verified_facts.excerpt: A vibrant homage to the purebred Arabian horse

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the hotel's private stables, where Selman Arabians are bred.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our private stables and immerse yourself in the captivating universe of Selman Arabians breeding

verified_facts.text: Signature experiences include a dinner in the stables, basics of dressage and working in liberty with the horses.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Signature dinner in the stables

verified_facts.text: Private villas sit within the hotel's gardens, with Arab-Moorish design by Jacques Garcia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled within the hotel's gardens, five private villas elevate the excellence of this haven, embodying the full sensuality of Arab-Moorish design, masterfully orchestrated by Jacques Garcia

verified_facts.text: The villas span 580 to 700 square meters.
verified_facts.excerpt: these exclusive gems, spanning 580 to 700 square meters

verified_facts.text: Each suite has a bedroom, a living room and one or two terraces overlooking the pool and Andalusian gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: each suite comprises a bedroom, a living room, and one or two terraces overlooking the majestic pool and Andalusian gardens

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Premier Rooms are 55 square meters with views of the pool and the Andalusian gardens, detailed by Jacques Garcia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering breathtaking views of the 80m long pool and the Andalusian gardens of the hotel, these 55-square-meter havens unveil a subtle Oriental refinement interpreted in every detail by Jacques Garcia.

verified_facts.text: The Suites and Suites Premier span 120 square meters and combine Jacques Garcia's style with Moroccan interiors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Symbols of the union between the contemporary elegance of Jacques Garcia's signature and the refinement of Moroccan interiors, our Suites span 120 square meters.

verified_facts.text: The Chenot Spa covers 1,200 square meters and recalls the heated baths of old Istanbul.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Chenot Spa at Selman Marrakech covers a sumptuous 1200 mètres carrés reminiscent of the heated baths of antique Istanbul

verified_facts.text: The hotel is one of six palaces in the world with a Chenot Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel is one of the 6 palaces in the world to have a Chenot Spa.

verified_facts.text: The spa has seven treatment rooms, four hydrotherapy rooms, a hydro-massage pool, two heated outdoor pools, two hammams, a gym and a boutique.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are seven treatment rooms, four hydrotherapy rooms, a hydro-massage pool, two heated outdoor pools, two hammams, a gym and a boutique for essentials.

verified_facts.text: The Chenot Spa offers 3, 5 or 10-day retreats, including the Chenot Relax Programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chenot SPA offers a variety of 3, 5 or 10-day retreats including the Chenot Relax Programme designed to detoxify, energize, regenerate and destress the nervous system.

verified_facts.text: The Chenot Spa is unique in Morocco.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unique in Morocco, the Spa at Selman Marrakech is signed by Chenot

verified_facts.text: Activities on offer include nearby golf courses, horse riding and trekking in the nearby Atlas Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: swimming pools, fitness center, nearby golf courses, horse riding experiences or trekking in the near Atlas mountains

verified_facts.text: Le Pavillon's Sunday brunch includes a parade of the hotel's Arabian horses.
verified_facts.excerpt: while enjoying a horse parade featuring the hotel's prestigious Arabian Horses

verified_facts.text: Le Pavillon overlooks the stud farm and its paddocks in the hotel's Spring Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the verdant expanses of the stud farm and its paddocks, Le Pavillon invites you to an open-air gastronomic experience, nestled in the heart of the hotel's sumptuous Spring Garden.

verified_facts.text: Assyl serves Moroccan cuisine prepared by an exclusively female brigade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Curated under the expertise of an exclusively female brigade, the Assyl restaurant invites you to embark on a journey through this ancestral culinary art

verified_facts.text: SABO sits beneath an open-roof patio and extends into the palace's library-bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled beneath an open-roof Patio that reveals the starry sky, the restaurant also extends into the palace's library-bar for a more intimate setting.

verified_facts.text: Le Bar Selman offers a choice of cigars.
verified_facts.excerpt: For cigar enthusiasts, a choice of the finest brands enhances these moments of relaxation.
